hero.title: Hospitality Management in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: For students interested in hotel operations, tourism, resort management, food and beverage services and event planning, Mauritius is a destination to consider. Its hospitality-related programs are able to teach students practical service skills and knowledge of business management. Studying **Hospitality Management in Mauritius** can help students explore undergraduate and postgraduate opportunities in the hospitality and tourism sector.

overview: The University of Mauritius will be offering the BSc (Hons) Tourism, Hospitality and Events Management, which is listed as a 3.5 year full time degree and the MSc Tourism and Hospitality Management, which is listed as a two year part time program for the academic year 2026-2027.

faq.question: Can I pursue Hospitality Management in Mauritius after Class 12?
faq.answer: Yes . If you have completed secondary education and meet the entry requirements of the institution, you can apply for an undergraduate program in hospitality. University of Mauritius BSc (Hons) Tourism, Hospitality and Events Management. Students can consider a Bachelor's in Hospitality Management in Mauritius after Class 12 if they meet the required criteria.

faq.question: How long is a Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality Management in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius offers a full-time 3.5 year BSc (Hons) Tourism, Hospitality and Events Management program. The Open University of Mauritius lists its BSc (Hons) Hotel Management and Catering Technologies as a four-to-six year program.

faq.question: Is there a Masters in Hospitality Management in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Yup. The University of Mauritius is offering an MSc Tourism and Hospitality Management program of two years part-time duration for the academic year 2026-2027. This is an option for students interested in a Master's in Hospitality Management in Mauritius.

faq.question: What is the tuition fee of Hospitality Management in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Fees vary by institution and by type of student. The tuition fee for international non-SADC students for the BSc (Hons) Hotel Management and Catering Technologies at The Open University of Mauritius is US\$5,750. Candidates are advised to check the latest fee before applying.

faq.question: What jobs can I get after studying Hospitality Management in Mauritius ?
faq.answer: Graduates may find work in hotel operations, front office services, food and beverage management, resort administration, event planning, tourism operations, hospitality marketing, and other areas. Career advancement is based on your qualifications, experience, skills, and your eligibility to work. Choosing Hospitality Management in Mauritius can help students build academic knowledge and practical skills for the hospitality and tourism industry. Before applying, compare the available Hospitality Management courses in Mauritius, check university requirements and confirm the latest tuition fees.
